rules.bch: every tracker story on the bill, not only the ones tied to this release: before = dated 2 to 7 days before, after = dated 1 day before to 7 days after; not linked = the after stories that are not this release's related, possibly related or copy stories
rules.copy: printed the release itself: runs of 25 or more identical words covering 90% of both texts, or 50% of a release of 250+ words, dated 1 day before to 30 days after; also release-wire reposts of its title (PublicNow)

anchor: names the release's rare names and figures, dated the release day to 7 days after
bill: Same bill, same topic, in the coverage wave
carries one of its bills and is on its subject, dated 1 day before to 7 days after, or 8 to 30 days after when no newer release on the bill came out in between
later: same bill and session, dated 8 to 30 days after, before the next release on the bill
laterquote: quotes at least 20 words of it, more than 7 days after
nearcopy: 60% or more of the story is the release's own text
possible: Same bill, same week (topic not checked)
same bill, dated 1 day before to 7 days after; the subject could not be checked (not in English, or no saved text)
pre: Covered the announcement before the release
reported the same announcement before it went out, dated 1 to 14 days before
quote: quotes at least 20 words of it, dated 1 day before to 30 days after
roundup: uses its text (passages of 25 or more identical words) inside a roundup, newsletter or column whose headline and opening are on other subjects
subject: Similar subject, no shared name or bill (not checked)
Similar subject
a close match on subject that names Gabriel but shares no bill or rare name with it, dated 1 day before to 7 days after; not checked
text: shares passages of 25 or more identical words with it, dated 1 day before to 90 days after
topic: Same subject and a shared name or bill
a close match on subject that names Gabriel and shares a bill or a rare name with it, dated 1 day before to 7 days after
